subject: Two-tier demo scheduling — security & procurement joining, need to re-sequence
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Morgan <sasha.morgan@blueshorehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Two-tier demo scheduling — security & procurement joining, need to re-sequence

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for coordinating the demo with Blueshore. We had penciled in July 1 for a 90-minute product walk-through focused on platform/infra and performance characteristics. Before I lock the invite I wanted to confirm attendees and make sure that the agenda covers the right topics for your team.

High-level proposal (attached: demo-agenda-v2.pdf):
- 90m tech deep-dive (model selection, latency targets, VPC/private deployment options)
- Live Q&A + short runbook walkthrough

Can you confirm the proposed date/time works for the core product + infra folks? Also, if procurement or governance need a separate conversation, we can schedule a follow-up the next day — happy to propose options.

If you can share any specific questions or a short list of attendees, I’ll tailor the agenda and make sure the right folks from here join (Rishi will lead the tech portion; Marissa will own onboarding/governance items).

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf (14 KB)

From: Sasha Morgan <sasha.morgan@blueshorehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@blueshorehealth.com>, Evan Li <evan.li@blueshorehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Two-tier demo scheduling — security & procurement joining, need to re-sequence

Hi Vivek —

Appreciate the agenda. Quick note from our side: Evan (our CISO) and a procurement rep need to attend — procurement will need the contract timeline and a short SSO/data-retention walkthrough. Unfortunately Evan will be traveling on July 1 (overnight flight) and cannot make the original slot.

Can we do the following instead?
- Tech deep-dive: July 1 or July 6 (preferred for our infra lead)
- Governance/procurement: July 2 or July 7 (Evan available July 2 afternoon)

Procurement asked that we keep the governance session to 45–60 minutes and focus on: data flows, retention, audit logs, SOC 2 evidence, and contract milestones. I’ve CC’d procurement and Evan so they can chime in with exact availability.

Thanks — Sasha
Sasha Morgan
Director, Platform Partnerships
Blueshore Health
sasha.morgan@blueshorehealth.com | +1 206-555-7890

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Two-tier demo scheduling — security & procurement joining, need to re-sequence

Folks —

Per Sasha, Blueshore needs security and procurement included; Evan (CISO) is out on the original date. That means two things for us:
1) We should formally split the engagement into two sessions (technical deep-dive + governance/procurement) rather than cram both into one long call.
2) We need to prepare a condensed governance deck and a short procurement milestone sheet so procurement has what they need for review. I started a quick MAP/questions doc (attached: MAP-questions.xlsx) with likely asks from procurement.

Proposed plan:
- Session A — Technical deep-dive (90 minutes)
  - Owner: Rishi (model ops, throughput, latency, KV caching, quantization strategies)
  - Proposed windows: July 1 10:00–11:30 PT OR July 6 09:00–10:30 PT
- Session B — Governance & Procurement (60 minutes)
  - Owner: Marissa (onboarding controls, SOC 2 artifacts, retention, contract timeline)
  - Proposed windows: July 2 13:00–14:00 PT OR July 7 14:00–15:00 PT

Kimberly — can you own the procurement milestone doc and confirm our standard timelines for a Dedicated customer (SLA/installation, reserved capacity commit windows)? Rishi — can you confirm you can lead the tech deep-dive and whether you want additional infra folks on the call?

Once we lock windows I’ll create separate calendar invites and a short pre-read for each session.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0137

Attachments: MAP-questions.xlsx (8 KB), demo-agenda-v2.pdf (14 KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Morgan <sasha.morgan@blueshorehealth.com>, Evan Li <evan.li@blueshorehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procure@blueshorehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Two-tier demo scheduling — security & procurement joining, need to re-sequence

Sasha / Evan / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick responses and the availability windows. We’ll proceed with the two-session approach. Below are the calendar links for the proposed slots — please click to accept and I’ll confirm presenters and pre-reads two business days before each session.

Session A — Technical deep-dive (90m)\- Proposed: July 1, 10:00–11:30 PT\- Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=tech-slot-20270701

Alternate: July 6, 09:00–10:30 PT (if you prefer that date)

Session B — Governance & Procurement (60m)\- Proposed: July 2, 13:00–14:00 PT\- Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=governance-slot-20270702

Action items assigned:
- Rishi: lead Session A + invite one infra engineer (Vincent) for kernel/throughput Qs
- Marissa: lead Session B + draft a 4-slide pre-read on SOC 2 evidence and logs
- Kimberly: confirm Dedicated onboarding timelines and procurement milestones (I asked her to add the milestone doc to the invite)

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf, MAP-questions.xlsx (see earlier)

If either session or slot still conflicts for you, tell us which of the alternates you prefer. Otherwise I’ll send the invites by tomorrow morning.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
